scripts.name: playerbots.cautious-flee
scripts.source:
local me = event.actor
if not me then return end
local level = me.level
if level > 30 then level = 30 end
-- A level 1 bot bolts at 39%, a level 30 one holds to 10%: the low-level bot has nothing to spend
-- and everything to lose.
local share = 40 - level
-- Already under half: leave a little earlier than it would have.
if me.max_health > 0 and me.health * 2 <= me.max_health then share = share + 10 end
return share

scripts.name: playerbots.steady-heal
scripts.source:
local me, ally = event.actor, event.target
if not me or not ally or ally.max_health == 0 then return end
-- A bigger health pool than the healer's is the member taking the hits. The rotation row's own
-- share stands for it, so it is caught as early as the row allows.
if ally.max_health > me.max_health then return 100 end
-- Everybody else waits until they are properly hurt, which keeps the mana for the one being hit.
return 45
